sections.text:
When the differential pressure drop
across the filter reaches the predetermined differential (5 PSI suggested),
replace the filter after taken out of service 
and the individual element replaced,

Mount the elements in the vessel on supports and held
in place by wing nuts. (it is
not necessary to remove the supports to change the elements). In general, cleaning of fibrous filter elements is not considered
practicable.

Replace the elements, by removing the wing nuts by turning counter clockwise, 
and after removing them, with drawing the element.
Reverse the procedure to install the new element.

Always compare the old and news elements to ascertain that the proper 
replacement is being made.
